# C0.5 candidate rig contract (experimental)

**Proposal, not accepted.** This contract is a candidate geometry for the owner to review. It does not replace the L1 test rig, the master rig, or any contract decision.

`rig.contract.json` is generated by code from the L1 test rig contract (`packages/rig-runtime/test/fixtures/l1-owner/rig.contract.json`):

```sh
node packages/control/dist/src/cli.js candidate --base packages/rig-runtime/test/fixtures/l1-owner/rig.contract.json --out <new-dir>
```

A test regenerates it and compares the bytes. Prettier does not format this folder (see `.prettierignore`).

Changed from the L1 base: joints of all bones except `aim`, all attachment rectangles, the `grip`, `muzzle` and `fx_hit` points,
new points `head_top`, `face_nose`, `face_eye_near`, `face_eye_far`, `face_ear_near`, `rigId`, `contractVersion`, and `spine` (no skeleton exists for this geometry).
Not changed: bone ids, parents and roles, slot ids, bones, draw order, required flags, categories and overlaps, animations, tolerances, space, view, side naming, mirroring.

See the [C0.5 report](../../../../../docs/proposals/C05_REFERENCE_MANNEQUIN.md).
